name: Circle of East Binding
summary: In eastern Arathi, water elementals guard the Circle of East Binding, southwest of Hammerfall. At its heart, the Stone of East Binding draws fierce contest.

sections.title: The Eastern Ward
sections.body: East of Stromgarde, the Circle of East Binding lies among Arathi's rugged highlands. The Stone of East Binding rises at its center, charged with elemental magic. Cresting exiles roam the ground around it. These swirling water elementals fiercely defend the stone from any mortal who approaches.

sections.title: Elemental Imprisonment
sections.body: Ancient stones across Arathi bind volatile elemental forces. Around the eastern circle, restless water spirits show the strain on those wards. Drawn to the stone's magic or trapped by it, they lash out at travelers on the nearby road to Hammerfall.

faq.q: Where is the Circle of East Binding located?
aliases: where is circle of east binding
faq.answer: The Circle of East Binding lies in eastern Arathi, south of the main road and southwest of Hammerfall, the Horde camp.

aliases: what monsters are at east binding
faq.answer: Aggressive water elementals called cresting exiles roam the circle and guard the Stone of East Binding.

faq.q: Why are there water elementals in the highlands?
faq.answer: Ancient stones across Arathi bind elemental forces. The water elementals here may be held by the eastern ward stone or drawn to its energy.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Stone of East Binding?
aliases: what does east binding stone do
faq.answer: The Stone of East Binding belongs to a network of binding stones across the Arathi Highlands. They were built to anchor, channel, and imprison volatile elemental forces.

angles.text: As a shaman, you may see Arathi's binding stones as an ancient way to suppress elemental forces, far from the balance and communion you seek.
Just down the road from Hammerfall, volatile water spirits around the circle trouble Horde patrols and supply lines.
